impacts.text: enabling standard functionality inadvertently exposes all user funds to theft by any attacker, regardless of KYC status
Bob can call `withdraw(..., receiver=Bob, owner=Alice)`. The vault sees that `allowance[Alice][Alice]` is sufficient, burns Alice's shares, and sends the assets to Bob
Bob **does not need to be KYC verified** to receive the underlying assets
Any user who enables transfers (a core token functionality) immediately exposes their entire vault balance to theft by **any attacker**
